Task: Identify if tokens in the sequence are anagrams of the word 'listen'.
Examples (input tokens -> output per position):
  ['BOS', 'V', 'poiVg', 'LB', 'poiVg', 'b', 'LB', 'V', 'no', 'oCLrZaW'] -> ['BOS', False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False]
  ['BOS', 'poiVg', 'TPSI', 'b', 'TPSI', 'no', 'b', 'poiVg', 'no', 'LB'] -> ['BOS', False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False]
  ['BOS', 'no', 'V', 'oCLrZaW', 'b', 'no', 'TPSI', 'no', 'oCLrZaW', 'b'] -> ['BOS', False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False]
  ['BOS', 'V', 'oCLrZaW', 'oCLrZaW', 'TPSI', 'listen', 'b', 'LB', 'oCLrZaW', 'listen'] -> ['BOS', False, False, False, False, True, False, False, False, True]
  ['BOS', 'LB', 'b', 'J', 'listen', 'poiVg', 'J', 'TPSI', 'no', 'V'] -> ['BOS', False, False, False, True, False, False, False, False, False]
Input token ids: {"BOS": 0, "J": 1, "LB": 2, "PAD": 3, "TPSI": 4, "V": 5, "b": 6, "listen": 7, "no": 8, "oCLrZaW": 9, "poiVg": 10}
Output classes: {"0": false, "1": true}
Architecture: 2 layers, d_model 4, 4 heads of size 1, MLP width 16 with gelu, causal attention, normalization none, learned positions, context 10. Residual stream: x = W_E[token] + W_pos[position]. Each block adds its attention heads, then its MLP. Logits = x W_U + b_U at every position.
Components:
  L0_MLP: the MLP output of block 0
